tldr: The paper introduces WorkArena, a benchmark of 33 enterprise tasks (19,912 instances) based on the ServiceNow platform, and BrowserGym, a web agent evaluation framework, finding that current LLM-based agents still have a considerable gap toward full task automation on real-world enterprise workflows.
contributions: WorkArena: a realistic enterprise benchmark of 33 tasks comprising 19,912 unique instances based on the ServiceNow platform

BrowserGym: a new OpenAI Gym-compatible framework for web agent development and evaluation, offering multimodal observations (DOM, AXTree, screenshots), rich action spaces (Python code, high-level primitives), chat-based interactions, and support for nested iFrames and shadow DOMs

Empirical study evaluating state-of-the-art LLM-based agents on WorkArena, plus an analysis of BrowserGym feature impact; notably, BrowserGym brings GPT-4 to 25.4% on WebArena versus the original 14.4%
methods: The authors built WorkArena on the ServiceNow platform, with tasks covering lists (filtering/sorting), forms, knowledge bases, service catalogs, dashboards, and menus. Each task is coupled with an explicit natural language goal and includes validation functions (real-time error feedback) and oracle functions (hand-crafted Playwright solutions). They introduced BrowserGym, a Chromium-based OpenAI Gym environment following a POMDP paradigm, providing multimodal observations and customizable action spaces. They then ran empirical evaluations of multiple LLM-based agents on WorkArena and analyzed the impact of different BrowserGym features on WorkArena and MiniWoB.
results: Current agents show promise but there remains a considerable gap toward full task automation. A significant performance disparity exists between open and closed-source LLMs. BrowserGym features brought a GPT-4 agent to 25.4% on WebArena, up from the original paper's 14.4%. WorkArena contains 19,912 unique instances across 33 tasks: 6,900 list instances, 5,000 form instances, 1,000 knowledge base instances, 3,550 service catalog instances, 1,862 dashboard instances, and 1,600 menu instances.
limitations: ServiceNow pages have prohibitively large DOMs (40k–500k tokens after cleaning), posing challenges for context understanding. The platform uses non-standard, highly dynamic UIs and exotic HTML (nested iFrames, shadow DOMs, proprietary APIs), requiring strong out-of-distribution generalization. The empirical evaluation scope is limited to language-model-based reasoning agents. The paper excerpt truncates before listing full quantitative results across all models.
